Target company: Microsoft (MSFT). Microsoft develops software and cloud services including Windows, Microsoft 365 and Azure, and operates gaming, business-software and related technology businesses.

Focal announcement: Your AI Companion.

Decision cutoff: 2025-04-04T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Your AI Companion. Published date: 2025-04-04. URL: https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2025/04/04/your-ai-companion.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: As I look back on the incredible impact that Microsoft has had over its now 50 years of relentless innovation, I’m inspired by the simplicity and power of Bill Gates’ bold ambition all those years ago: to put a PC on every desk and in every home. With your permission, Copilot will now remember what you talk about, so it learns your likes and dislikes and details about your life: the name of your dog, that tricky project at work, what keeps you motivated to stick to your new workout routine. Copilot will understand you in the context of your life, and show up, on your terms, in the right way at the right time. Use simple chat prompts to ask Copilot to book event tickets, grab dinner reservations or send a thoughtful gift to a friend and it will check that task off your list. Copilot Actions will work with most websites across the web, and we’re particularly excited to highlight our launch partners: 1-800-Flowers.com, Booking.com, Expedia, Kayak, OpenTable, Priceline, Tripadvisor, Skyscanner, Viator and Vrbo.
